subjects.appearance_details: Muddy hooves and lower legs, wet muzzles, ear tags visible on several animals, some with rounded bellies, tails swishing occasionally
subjects.relationship: Primary obstacle ahead of the ego vehicle, being driven by the farmer behind them
subjects.location: center and filling the full width of the lane ahead, foreground to midground
subjects.orientation: Facing toward the camera as they walk toward and around the ego vehicle
subjects.pose: Standing and walking on all four legs, heads lowered, slow ambling gait
subjects.action: Walking slowly toward and past the stationary ego vehicle
subjects.state_changes: The herd approaches, grows larger in frame, and begins to flow around the vehicle as it stops

subjects.description: A farmer in weatherproof outdoor clothing walking behind the herd, driving the cattle down the lane
subjects.appearance_details: Wearing a flat cap or beanie, a waxed green jacket, dark trousers, and wellington boots, possibly holding a stick
subjects.relationship: Herder controlling and following the cattle behind them
subjects.location: background, partly obscured behind the herd, center of lane
subjects.orientation: Facing toward the camera, walking behind the cattle
subjects.pose: Upright, walking, arms occasionally raised to guide the animals
subjects.action: Following and guiding the herd down the lane
subjects.state_changes: Remains behind the herd, slowly becoming more visible as cattle pass
subjects.clothing: Waxed green jacket, dark trousers, wellington boots, flat cap
subjects.facial_features: Partly obscured by distance and cap; ruddy complexion, short greying hair

background_setting: A narrow single-track rural country lane flanked on both sides by tall, dense green hedgerows. The tarmac is slightly wet and patched with mud and cow dung. The lane curves gently ahead into the hedged corridor. Overcast grey sky provides flat, even lighting. Occasional glimpses of farmland and trees rise beyond the hedgerows.

lighting.direction: Diffuse, top-down ambient light from a fully clouded sky
lighting.shadows: Soft, faint shadows beneath the cattle and hedgerows
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, muted illumination with low contrast and cool tones, typical of a cloudy day

aesthetics.composition: Centered ego-perspective looking straight down the lane, hedgerows framing both sides forming a natural corridor toward the approaching herd
aesthetics.color_scheme: Muted greens of hedgerows, grey tarmac and sky, black-and-white and brown of cattle
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Calm, patient, rural, everyday countryside encounter
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating forms of cattle bodies and the linear texture of hedgerows

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from driver's ego perspective
cinematography.focus: The approaching herd and lane ahead

context: Autonomous driving or dashcam scenario depicting yielding to livestock on a rural road

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward along the narrow hedgerow-lined lane and spots the herd of cattle filling the lane ahead.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The ego vehicle comes to a complete stop well before the herd and remains stationary as cattle walk toward and around it, with the farmer following behind; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

segments.key_changes: Herd grows larger in frame as vehicle approaches; forward speed begins to reduce.

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle travels forward along the narrow hedgerow-lined lane and spots the herd of cattle filling the lane ahead. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient countryside sounds dominate: the low rumble of the idling engine, the soft squeal and hum of brakes engaging, the shuffling of many hooves on wet tarmac, intermittent low moos and bellows from the cattle, birdsong from the hedgerows, and the occasional distant call of the farmer directing the herd.
